title: NASA Beat Nature With 0.0000000001 Kelvin Cold
hook: NASA reached 0.0000000001 kelvin—colder than any known natural setting.
closing: Human-made cold lets nearby experiments probe physics nature cannot reproduce.
question: What could ultracold atoms reveal?

segments.say: Cold space sits at 2.7 kelvin, but the Boomerang Nebula still goes lower.
NASA's Cold Atom Lab reached 0.0000000001 kelvin, taking matter colder than nature's known settings.
The cold experiment sits only 250 miles overhead, bringing extreme physics within reach.
